chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 167: Li Huowang Offers Himself to Bashe in the Intercalating Ritual
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang performs the forbidden Intercalating of the Five Phases, offering his organs to Bashe to deny Danyangzi his body. A chapter of pure, irreversible sacrifice.
og_title: The Self Sacrificed: Li Huowang's Final Gambit with the Thousand Greats Record
og_description: In a last-ditch effort to stop Danyangzi from taking over, Li Huowang disembowels himself and replaces his organs with the writhing flesh-worms of the Thousand Greats Record.
twitter_title: No Pain, No Self: Li Huowang Becomes the Worm-Host
twitter_description: Li Huowang slices himself open and feeds his organs to Bashe to stop Danyangzi. The worms fill him up. The pain stops. And he can no longer tell where he ends.
